name: Reschedule Cancel

parameters.message: Hi, we couldn't find an upcoming appointment under this number. Please call us anytime and we'll be glad to help — Valfin Tech.

parameters.content: This workflow processes incoming SMS messages related to appointment changes, determines whether the customer wants to reschedule or cancel, updates the appointment records accordingly, sends a response back to the customer, and notifies the business owner of the request.
